subject: POC prompt & eval dataset collection - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@acmehealth.com>, Elena Torres <etorres@acmehealth.com>

Subject: POC prompt & eval dataset collection - next steps

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. As discussed, I wanted to summarize the proposed POC plan and the ask for example prompts/logs so our team can get the eval pipeline ready. High level:

- Objective / success criteria (please confirm):
  - Model responses meet accuracy and safety thresholds for physician-facing summaries (>= 90% factual accuracy on our eval set)
  - Latency under 350ms median for 512-token responses on Dedicated profile
  - No PHI leakage in outputs / must pass our PII checks

- Proposed timeline (flexible):
  - Week 0 (this week): dataset & prompt collection from Acme -> Redwood
  - Week 1: onboarding + run baseline eval on provided prompts/logs
  - Week 2: optimization (batching/quantization) + re-eval
  - Week 3: review call and handoff to CS if POC successful

- What we need from Acme:
  - A sample prompt set of ~200 representative prompts (CSV or JSONL). Include context fields if available (patient age, speciality).
  - Example model/chat logs (anonymized) for common flows (prescription reconcil, discharge summary QA).
  - Labels/expected outputs where possible (gold responses) or a rubric for grading.

Attached is a small template (poc_prompt_template.csv) to make export easier. Two requests re: data handling:
  1) Please redact direct identifiers (names, MRNs). If you cannot remove them, mark fields that contain PHI and we'll coordinate secure upload.
  2) Provide a single sample file and an ETA for the full set.

Ownership:
  - Acme data lead: Sanjay (confirm)
  - Redwood owner: Rishi (SE) for eval, Marissa for program/POC coordination

Next steps: Can you confirm who will share the files and an estimated delivery date? Also propose 30 mins next Tue/Wed for baseline review.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 07:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: POC prompt & eval dataset collection - next steps

Quick technical notes from the SE side — thanks for the sample file, Sanjay. A few requests so our eval is aligned with your expectations:

1) Format: JSONL is fine. For CSV/JSONL please include a unique prompt_id, input_text, context (if any), and expected_output (if available). If you include a "policy_flags" field that indicates PHI presence, that helps us route to secure pipelines.
2) Labels: CSV with prompt_id + expected_response_text + reviewer_id is perfect. If labels are in a separate file, include mapping to prompt_id.
3) Redaction guidance: please remove or hash direct identifiers. If hashing, include a note on salt or reproducibility. For any remaining PHI we'll coordinate an encrypted S3 transfer.
4) Evaluation metrics: confirm you care about the following so we can instrument them: factuality (F1 against gold), semantic similarity (BLEU/ROUGE or embedding cosine), safety flags (binary), and latency (p95/p50). If you prefer different metrics (e.g., clinical correctness rubric) share the rubric and we'll add it.
5) Size target: ideal sample is 200 prompts across flows; minimum 75 to run useful baselines.

If you can confirm the metric set and whether you'll provide gold responses for at least 30 items, we'll queue the baseline run this week.

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
